title: EPIPE handling removed
detail: The original code handled errno.EPIPE by pacifying stdout/stderr and exiting with code 1. The new code only raises for non-EPIPE errors, leaving EPIPE errors unhandled and causing the program to continue or crash unexpectedly.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: The Twisted lock object exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. This condition will always be truthy, causing the lock acquisition logic to misbehave.

title: Missing await on lock acquisition
detail: Acquiring the lock returns a Deferred that must be awaited in an async context. Calling it without awaiting will not actually acquire the lock and may lead to race conditions.
note: Anchored on the PR's deliberate un-awaited acquire (line 967); the same words fit the planted line 969.

title: Incorrect accept_html logic
detail: The property should return True when "text/html" is present in the Accept header, but the code returns True when it is NOT present, causing accept_html to always be False for valid headers.
